'''Peter Howard Haynes''' {{post-nominals|country=GBR | FRS}} (born 23 July 1958) is a British [[applied mathematics|applied mathematician]] in the [[Faculty of Mathematics, University of Cambridge|Faculty of Mathematics]] at the [[University of Cambridge]].  He is a Fellow of [[Queens' College, Cambridge]]<ref>{{cite web|title=Queens' College Directory of Fellows|url=http://www.queens.cam.ac.uk/page-1419|access-date=2012-08-23|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120220123828/http://www.queens.cam.ac.uk/page-1419|archive-date=2012-02-20|url-status=dead}}</ref> and served as head of the [[DAMTP|Department of Applied Mathematics and Theoretical Physics (DAMTP)]] from 2005 to 2015.<ref>{{cite web|title=DAMTP Professor Peter Haynes|url=http://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/people/p.h.haynes/}}</ref>

He was educated at the [[Royal Grammar School, Guildford]], and [[Queens' College, Cambridge]] (B.A. 1979, M.A. 1983, Ph.D. 1984).<ref>{{Cite book|doi=10.1093/ww/9780199540884.013.U42754|contribution=Haynes, Prof. Peter Howard, (born 23 July 1958), Professor of Applied Mathematics, University of Cambridge, since 2001 (Head, Department of Applied Mathematics and Theoretical Physics, 2005–15); Fellow, Queens' College, Cambridge, since 1986|date=1 December 2007|title=Who's Who & Who Was Who |isbn=978-0-19-954088-4 }}</ref>

==Research==
His research includes [[fluid dynamics]] and [[atmospheric dynamics]].<ref name=HaynesMcIntyre1991>{{cite journal|last1=Haynes|first1=P. H.|last2=McIntyre|first2=M. E.|author2-link=Michael E.
